summary: Gravel bushland car park just east of the pin, full of parked cars.
reasons: Pin in bush; gravel car park beside it
Many cars parked, off the road

drivers.seclusion: Bush on three sides, road on the fourth; no buildings within 100 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Open gravel area joined to the road with parking aisle; room well clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy winding main road alongside, but the van stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Dense rows of parked cars in the QLD image show it is used all day.

flags: Pin lands in bush beside East Ithaca Creek, so the pin is off, not the place
Steep ground around: up to 38% in the bush, car park itself flatter
Road noise from Sir Samuel Griffith Drive
sun_shade: Tall trees shade the car park from the west; open sky to the east and north.

best_section.where: Gravel car park on the west side of Sir Samuel Griffith Drive, about 20 m east of the pin
